title: Riot Squad | PUNX | Strawberry Pink Apple 60ml
description:
Riot Squad | PUNX | Strawberry Pink Apple 60ml
The Punx range is from renowned UK e-liquid brand Riot Squad, with this collection dedicated to layered fruit combinations with a punk theme.
Strawberry And Pink Apple shortfill e-liquid by Riot Squad Punx is a sweet fruit flavour that’s ideal for an all-day vape. The juicy taste of strawberry comes through straight away, complemented by crisp notes of apple.
